name: mahi-overload-backpressure

base_results.finding: current clean live reference after nginx isolation
six-ingress healthy-host topology accepted 5.28M requests but left Mahi pools full and diverged state roots

hypothesis: Mahi observer ingress currently reports async relay success before the owner has durable capacity. Under overload, accepted work can outrun owner pre-admitted drain, fill bounded owner pools, and break the benchmark correctness invariant. Add bounded observer relay admission and owner-side pre-admitted high-water retry semantics so overload becomes client-visible retry/backpressure instead of accepted-but-uncommitted backlog.

planned_config.rationale: Keep enough buffer for the item-251 clean topology while making overload visible before each owner reaches the hard 524,288-item pool cap.

planned_live_steps.description: build release binary from the tagged experiment commit
deploy default three-ingress topology with committed backpressure env
wipe state and restart default live topology
planned_live_steps.command: cd chain/deploy/ansible && KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=$(grep -m1 '^KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=' /tmp/and-live-testnet/validator-1.env | cut -d= -f2-) .venv/bin/ansible kombat_live_testnet -m shell -a 'systemctl stop kombat-chain-ingress3 kombat-chain-ingress2 kombat-chain-ingress kombat-chain && rm -rf /var/lib/and-chain && mkdir -p /var/lib/and-chain/snapshots && chown -R and-chain:and-chain /var/lib/and-chain && systemctl start kombat-chain && systemctl start kombat-chain-ingress kombat-chain-ingress2 kombat-chain-ingress3'

success_criteria.accepted_work_semantics: new overload tests prove async observer relay reports retry when its bounded relay queue cannot accept more work, and owner relay returns retry at the configured pre-admitted high-water mark

rollback.disable_new_behavior: set KOMBAT_MAHI_OBSERVER_RELAY_QUEUE_MAX_ITEMS and KOMBAT_MAHI_PRE_ADMITTED_BACKPRESSURE_ITEMS to 524288 or revert the experiment commit
rollback.live_topology: redeploy default three-ingress Ansible topology and wipe /var/lib/and-chain before the next run

observed.error: jsonrpc code=-32029 message=mahi owner relay queue full; retry

result.reason: The 65,536-item observer relay queue bound made overload explicit, but it also throttled the default 12-endpoint green topology and produced client-visible retries. The code path is useful, but the live default thresholds are too low.
result.next_move: Raise the default live backpressure thresholds above normal operating burst size in a separate tagged experiment, redeploy, wipe, and rerun the 100k/60s default topology.
